collection.title: Audi A6 Allroad 1999 to 2000 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi A6 Allroad 1999 - 2000 only requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
